items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 19 at 12:28PM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
At 1228 PM PST, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 8
miles southwest of Boulder Creek, or 11 miles northwest of Santa
Cruz, moving southeast at 35 mph.

HAZARD...Landspouts, wind gusts up to 40 mph, and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor damage to outdoor objects is possible. Gusty winds
could knock down tree limbs and blow around unsecured
objects.

Locations impacted include...
Santa Cruz, Scotts Valley, Capitola, Live Oak, Felton, Twin Lakes,
Opal Cliffs, Soquel, Aptos and Rio Del Mar.
items.instruction:
Monitor the weather situation closely and be alert for threatening
weather conditions.

items.headline: Flood Advisory issued November 19 at 10:30AM PST until November 19 at 1:30PM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Coastal San Francisco peninsula and Santa Cruz Mountains

* WHEN...Until 130 PM PST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1029 AM PST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain. This will
cause urban and small stream flooding.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 0.75 inches are expected
over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Daly City, Palo Alto, Santa Cruz, Watsonville, Gilroy, San Bruno,
Pacifica, Saratoga, Los Gatos, Corralitos, Scotts Valley, Half
Moon Bay, Capitola, Live Oak and Woodside.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
items.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued November 19 at 8:16AM PST until November 19 at 3:00PM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and seas
7 to 11 ft expected.

* WHERE...Monterey Bay.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM PST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for severe conditions.

items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 19 at 12:02PM PST until November 20 at 4:00AM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 18 to 24 ft with up to 30 ft at
favored break points.

* WHERE...All Pacific Coast Beaches.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Large breaking waves can overpower swimmers, pulling
people into the sea from beaches, jetties, and rocks resulting
in significant physical injury and increasing the risk of
drowning. Waves can sweep across the shoreline without
warning, pulling people into the sea from beaches, jetties,
and rocks.
items.instruction:
Swimmers should remain out of the water due to dangerous surf
conditions.
